app.description: Ask Away! – free, simple and tracking-free live Q&A for your events.

footer.tagline: Ask Away! · made with 💜 · simple & tracking-free

home.tagline: Free, simple and tracking-free live Q&A. No sign-up for your audience.
home.loginToCreateTitle: Log in to start a session
home.loginToCreateText: On this instance, only people with an account can create events.

noSignup.title: No sign-up
noSignup.text: Your audience scans a QR code and asks away – anonymously as a cute animal, if they like.

bigScreen.title: Made for the big screen
bigScreen.text: A presenter view with QR code, live votes and a spotlight for the question being answered.

trackingFree.title: Tracking-free
trackingFree.text: No ads, no trackers. Events are deleted automatically once they're over.

ask.label: Your question
ask.placeholder: What would you like to ask? 💭
ask.sentModerated: Sent! 💌 A moderator will have a quick look and then it'll show up.
ask.moderatedHint: Questions are checked by a moderator before they appear.
ask.rejected: 🙈 This one didn't make it onto the screen.
ask.emptyText: Be the first to ask something! 🌟

identity.title: Who are you today?
identity.nameHint: Optional. Leave it empty to stay anonymous. Applies to questions you ask from now on.

newsletter.title: Stay in touch with {org}?
newsletter.name: Name
newsletter.doubleOptIn: We'll send you an email to confirm. Nothing is kept without your confirmation.
newsletter.checkInboxText: Click the link in the email to confirm your sign-up.
newsletter.confirmedText: {org} will keep you up to date. Thanks for coming to «{title}»!

present.here: No one here yet | {count} person here | {count} people here
present.emptyText: Scan the code in the corner and ask away 💭

admin.welcomeText: This page is your control room. It's saved in this browser – log in to keep it safe across devices.
admin.welcomeTextAccount: This page is your control room. It's saved in your account, so you'll find it under «My events» on any device.
admin.screenHelp: Switch what the presenter view shows – it updates live.
admin.moderationOffHint: Approval is switched off: new questions appear immediately. You can still hide or delete them.
admin.queueEmptyText: New questions waiting for approval show up here.
admin.liveEmptyText: Approved questions show up here, sorted like on the big screen.

share.participantHint: Share this or show the join screen – that's where people ask and vote.
share.presentHint: Open this on the computer connected to the projector.
share.modHint: Moderators can approve questions and switch the screen, but can't change settings or delete the event.
share.noModLink: Create a link to invite people who help you moderate.
share.rotateConfirm: Create a new moderator link? The old one stops working immediately.
share.ownerWarning: Keep this one to yourself 🤫 Anyone with it has full control over the event.
share.accountTitle: Keep it safe in your account
share.accountText: Right now this event is only saved in this browser. Add it to your account to find it again from any device – and to collect newsletter sign-ups.

settings.title: Title
settings.moderationLabel: New questions need approval before they appear
settings.moderationHelp: When on, a moderator accepts each question before it shows up for everyone. When off, questions appear immediately.
settings.moderationStateOn: 🛡️ Currently: questions wait in «Waiting» until you accept them.
settings.moderationStateOff: ⚡ Currently: questions appear right away. Questions already waiting stay in the queue.
settings.newsletterIntro: When the event closes, participants can sign up to be kept up to date by you. Sign-ups use double opt-in.
settings.newsletterNeedsAccount: Add this event to your account (see «Share») to use this feature.
settings.newsletterNeedsMail: This needs email to be set up on this instance.
settings.newsletterPurposeHint: Be specific – people agree to exactly this.
settings.newsletterEnabledHelp: Appears on participants' phones once you close the event.
settings.privacyController: You (the sender above) are responsible for the sign-ups and how you use them.
settings.privacyMinimal: Only email and an optional name are collected – never linked to questions or votes.
settings.privacyRetention: Export the list in time: it's deleted with the event, {days} days after closing.
settings.exportIntro: Download the questions for your notes or a follow-up.
settings.deleteSubscribersConfirm: Delete all sign-ups for this event? Export them first if you still need them.
settings.closeHelp: Stops new questions and votes and shows a thank-you screen.
settings.closeConfirm: Close the event? No more questions or votes after this (you can reopen it).
settings.reopenHelp: Let people ask and vote again.
settings.deleteHelp: Removes everything right away. Otherwise it's deleted automatically {days} days after closing.
settings.deleteConfirm: Really delete «{title}» with all questions? This can't be undone.

login.title: Hi there! 👋
login.intro: No password needed – we'll email you a 6-digit code.
login.checkInbox: We've sent a code to {email}. It's valid for 10 minutes.

events.accountEmpty: No events in your account yet
events.browserHint: Events you created or moderate in this browser. Log in to keep them safe across devices.
events.browserHintLoggedIn: Saved only in this browser. Open one and use «Share» → «Add to my account» to keep it.
events.loginCta: Log in to sync your events

errors.server_error: Oh no, something went wrong 🥺 Please try again.
errors.offline: Hmm, we can't reach the server 📡 Is your connection okay?
errors.slow_down: Woah, slow down 😮‍💨 You can try again in {retryAfter} seconds.
errors.event_not_found: We looked everywhere 🔍 but this event doesn't exist (anymore).
errors.question_empty: Your question seems a little shy 🙈 Type something first.
errors.question_too_long: That's a big one! 📜 Please keep it under {max} characters.
errors.question_locked: This question can't be changed anymore 🔒
errors.question_not_votable: This question can't be voted on right now 🤔
errors.question_not_approved: Accept the question first, then spotlight it 🎤
errors.no_access: This link doesn't open any doors 🚪 Check you've copied the complete link – or log in if the event is in your account.
errors.owner_only: Only the event owner can do that 👑
errors.registration_closed: This instance is invite-only 💌 Ask the host for access.
errors.invalid_email: That email looks a bit wonky 🤔
errors.invalid_code: That code didn't work 🔢 Check it or request a new one.
errors.invalid_code_format: Event codes have 6 characters, like K7F2Q9 🔤
errors.mail_not_configured: Logging in isn't set up on this instance yet 📭
errors.invalid_token: This link has expired or was already used ⏳
errors.invalid_url: Links need to start with https:// 🔗
errors.newsletter_unavailable: Sign-ups aren't available for this event 📭
errors.newsletter_incomplete: Please fill in who sends updates and what people get first ✍️
errors.consent_required: Please tick the box to confirm ☑️
errors.already_claimed: This event already belongs to another account 🔐
errors.no_participant: Your session got lost 🧭 Please reload the page.
errors.clipboard: Couldn't copy – please select and copy it by hand ✂️
errors.page_not_found: This page went on an adventure and didn't come back 🙈
